title: Canonical schema pre-use bootstrap for disposable Staging bundle builds

phases.objective: Bootstrap canonical baseline tables before ordered migrations in the disposable Staging schema builder, while preserving shared schema compatibility and forbidding Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the schema bundle builder against an exact clean commit with explicit BUILD_STAGING_SCHEMA_BUNDLE confirmation.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The disposable database receives dependency-safe canonical baseline tables before migrations consume them, ordered migration audit converges, and the three schema-only Staging bundles remain isolated from Production.
steps: Parse the canonical schema into deterministic statements and validate every statement before use.
Apply baseline tables whose dependencies are already satisfied before each ordered migration.
Revisit deferred baseline tables after each migration and fail closed if required objects remain unresolved.
Audit migration pre-use table and column dependencies against the same ordered bootstrap model.
Emit only schema bundles for the three isolated Staging database roles after all required tables exist.
assertions: Migrations cannot consume a canonical baseline table before it exists in the disposable database.
Foreign-key dependencies are resolved without disabling referential integrity.
The ordered audit reports no missing table or missing column dependencies.
Generated inventories and manifests remain deterministic and exact-head bound.
No Production database, provider, credential, deployment, or mutation is accessed.
